name: INABATA&Co.,Ltd.
india_angle: Inabata & Co., Ltd. has a local presence in India, providing semiconductor materials, equipment, and technical solutions.
summary: Inabata & Co., Ltd. is a distributor of semiconductor materials and equipment, offering solutions such as gas abatement systems, wafer-handling equipment, and IC/ASIC design services. The company supports its customers with sales, supply-chain coordination, and equipment maintenance services, leveraging a global supplier network.
